name: landing-page-roi-calculator
description: Calculates landing page CPA, ROAS, monthly conversions and revenue from ad spend and CVR inputs. Shows a 5-row scenario table comparing revenue impact of 0%, 10%, 25%, 50%, and 100% CVR improvements.

monthlyClicks.description: Monthly clicks or visitors from the campaign

currentCVR.description: Current landing page conversion rate as a percentage

valuePerConversion.description: Revenue value per conversion in EUR (AOV for ecommerce, deal value × close rate for B2B)
